reading.text:
Common setting (paper §1-§2, used by every reading below). Horizon T>0, dimensions n,m,d>=1.
H = R^n x R^m x R^{m x d} x L^2(nu;R^m) with the l^2-combined norm
|theta|_H^2 = |x|^2+|y|^2+|z|_F^2+||u||_{L^2(nu)}^2 (Euclidean on vectors, Frobenius on matrices,
L^2(nu) on the fibre; u an a.e.-class). P_2(H): Borel probability measures on H with finite second
moment, metrised by W_2 built on |.|_H. Coefficients are deterministic functions
b:[0,T]xHxP_2(H)->R^n, sigma:->R^{n x d}, h:->L^2(nu;R^n), f:->R^m, g:R^n x P_2(R^n)->R^m.
Diagonal input at t: Theta in L^2(Omega,F_t;H) on the standing basis together with mu=Law(Theta).
All hypotheses are diagonal (mu never varied independently of Theta), interior ones for a.e. t in
[0,T] with the null time set chosen before the inputs, terminal ones for all X_T,X'_T in
L^2(Omega,F_T;R^n) with induced laws rho=Law(X_T). The standing filtration is the usual augmentation
of the one generated by W, N and an independent F_0. Since the stability constant is claimed
dimension-free, norm choices matter: Euclidean/Frobenius/L^2(nu) norms (or a choice differing from
them only by dimension-free factors) are required wherever a definition enters a quantitative bound.

UNIT def:Dissertation.WellPosedness.Spec.Assumption25.mk
Paper notion: the constructor of the Lean structure encoding Assumption 2.5 (see the reading of
Spec.Assumption25): from the constant conditions (alpha,beta_1,beta_2>=0, alpha+beta_1>0,
beta_1+beta_2>0, beta_1>0 if m<n, alpha,beta_2>0 if m>n), the terminal G-monotonicity for all
X_T,X'_T in L^2(F_T) and the interior (2.7) for a.e. t over diagonal pairs, build the assumption.
Faithful iff its arguments are exactly the fields of a faithful Assumption25.

comparison.text:
Comparison: constructor Spec.Assumption25.mk vs locked reading.
Its three arguments are exactly the fields of Assumption25: the terminal statement (for all
F_T-strongly measurable square-integrable XT, XT', integrability of ⟪δg_T, G δX_T⟫ and
E⟪δg_T, G δX_T⟫ ≥ α E‖G δX_T‖²; the pretty-printer omits the [ℱ T] annotation of
StronglyMeasurable, which the field type carries), the interior statement ∀ᵐ t ∂(Lebesgue on
[0,T]), Mono27At, and Constants n m α β₁ β₂; it returns Assumption25 ℱ P T G α β₁ β₂ C. Nothing
extra, nothing missing; meaning that of Assumption25.
Verdict: faithful with representation choices (those of Assumption25).

verdict.detail:
Representation choices, each harmless:
1. Each expectation of a pairing (terminal ⟨δg_T, G δX_T⟩ and interior (2.7)) is encoded as
   "integrable, and its Bochner integral satisfies the inequality". The paper's expectations
   presuppose integrability; under Assumption 2.3 (assumed with 2.5 in every result) and joint
   measurability the pairings are integrable along L² diagonal inputs, so the conjuncts are
   automatic in the paper's setting, and they exclude the Bochner junk value 0.
2. G ∈ ℝ^{m×n} and α, β₁, β₂ are parameters; full rank of G is Assumption 2.4, stated
   separately. The admissibility conditions on the constants are the structure Constants, which
   lists all six conditions of the paper.
3. a.e. t is with respect to Lebesgue measure restricted to [0,T] (Icc 0 T).
